woofer.notes: 'MID-WOOFER One 3.5 in/9 cm mid-woofer' per the Sonos PLAY:1 specification sheet copy hosted on static.qobuz.com (not sonos.com). Single third-party copy; the sheet also lists one tweeter and two Class-D amplifiers, which agree with driverCount 2.

notes: Third-party copy of the Sonos PLAY:1 specification sheet (static.qobuz.com). The sheet publishes no frequency response, sensitivity, impedance or power rating, so none is stored. Pass-142 (2026-10-11): third-party tier applied to the mid-woofer diameter.

woofer.notes: 'It has a fairly typical 3.5-inch woofer' per thenextweb.com's measurement article on the Sonos Move (Gen 1, $399). Single third-party source; Sonos publishes no driver size on its shop page.

notes: Third-party measurement article (thenextweb.com, January 2020). The record is the first-generation Move; the Move 2 record is separate and is not merged. The article gives no frequency response, sensitivity, impedance or power figure that is usable, so none is stored. Pass-142 (2026-10-11): third-party tier applied to the woofer diameter.

woofer.notes: 3.0 in (76 mm) neodymium woofer per proaudiovideo.in ('Driver Size: 3.0" (76mm) neodymium woofer + two 0.8" (20mm) tweeters'). The same figure appears on mahajanelectronics.com ('3.0" woofer and dual 0.8" tweeters') and in the Amazon ASIN B085H3DKLT listing already recorded in notes. Two third-party copies agree.

notes: Third-party copies only (proaudiovideo.in; mahajanelectronics.com; Amazon listing). Both spec copies state Impedance and Sensitivity as N/A for this active, mains-powered speaker, so neither is stored. The 'full-range' frequency statement has no criterion and is not stored. Pass-142 (2026-10-11): third-party tier applied to the woofer diameter.
